name: io.github.evaspace/pierref
title: Opticars car database and pierref.eu
description: Search, compare and rank 5,000+ cars on 140 criteria (Opticars), plus the author profile and CV.

tools.name: morgan_profile
tools.description: Who Morgan Pierrefeu is: short bio, skills by domain, public links and contact. Use first for any question about Morgan.

tools.name: morgan_list_projects
tools.description:
List Morgan's projects (name, URL, year, tags, description). Optional case-insensitive filters:
category (e.g. DEPLOYMENTS) and tag (e.g. Python, FastAPI). Projects with mcp_tools can be queried directly through this server.

tools.name: morgan_get_project
tools.description: Details of one project. project_id is the id from list_projects (e.g. opticars, fusee, jeudi).

tools.name: morgan_cv
tools.description: Morgan's public CV in Markdown, same content as the PDF. lang: fr, en, zh or ru (default en).

tools.name: morgan_contact
tools.description: How to contact or hire Morgan: email (preferred), links, languages, availability. Answer the user in their own language.

tools.name: opticars_search_cars
tools.description: Search cars. Translate the user's request into parameters. Categorical values are stored in French: fuel_type 'Essence'/'Diesel'/'Électrique'/'Hybride'/'Hybride Rechargeable'/'GPL', transmission 'Manuelle'/'Automatique', drivetrain 'Propulsion'/'Traction'/'4x4'/'Intégrale'. Matching is a case-insensitive substring. numeric_filters keys are min_<criterion> or max_<criterion>, e.g. {"max_price": 30000, "min_horsepower": 200}. Price is in EUR, weight in kg, acceleration is 0-100 km/h in seconds (lower is better). Cars with a missing value for a filtered field are excluded. sort: a criterion or a score_* column (score_bang_buck, score_trackday_pro, score_family_trip, score_daily_eco, score_investment). Criteria: horsepower, torque_nm, weight, price, acceleration, top_speed, lateral_g, braking_distance, displacement, tank_size, cylinders, fuel_consumption_combined, co2_emissions, noise_level, rarity_score, reliability_rating, drag_coefficient, seats, doors, boot_capacity, previous_owners, occasion_price, fiscal_power, import_tax_estimated, days_on_market, estimated_margin, stage_1_hp, stage_1_nm, stage_2_hp, stage_2_nm, power_weight_ratio, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, wheelbase_mm, ground_clearance_mm, battery_capacity_kwh, electric_range_km, fast_charging_speed_kw. limit max 20.

tools.name: opticars_get_car
tools.description: Full public details of one car. car_id is the id_custom field returned by search_cars.

tools.name: opticars_compare_cars
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 cars side by side. car_ids are id_custom values from search_cars.

tools.name: opticars_recommend
tools.description: Rank cars for a need. Either weights {criterion: importance>0} (e.g. {"horsepower": 3, "price": 2}) or preset in family, trackday, daily, investment. Criteria where lower is better (price, weight, acceleration, consumption) are handled automatically. filters use the same keys as search_cars (mark, fuel_type, max_price, min_seats...). Returns match_score 0-100. Criteria: horsepower, torque_nm, weight, price, acceleration, top_speed, lateral_g, braking_distance, displacement, tank_size, cylinders, fuel_consumption_combined, co2_emissions, noise_level, rarity_score, reliability_rating, drag_coefficient, seats, doors, boot_capacity, previous_owners, occasion_price, fiscal_power, import_tax_estimated, days_on_market, estimated_margin, stage_1_hp, stage_1_nm, stage_2_hp, stage_2_nm, power_weight_ratio, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, wheelbase_mm, ground_clearance_mm, battery_capacity_kwh, electric_range_km, fast_charging_speed_kw.
